page_title: DOR 2-0 AUG | Dortmund v Augsburg 14/03/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's the end of the match.
90+5' Anton Kade (Augsburg) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
90+3' The corner is flicked onto Serhou Guirassy (Dortmund), but his close-range header flies a whisker wide of the right post.
90+3' Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.

90+2' He should have scored! Serhou Guirassy (Dortmund) latches onto a pull back in the box right in front of goal, but his shot aimed inside the left post is pretty weak and Finn Dahmen makes an easy save. Dortmund have a corner.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Augsburg take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
90' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Karim Adeyemi departs the field of play to be replaced by Serhou Guirassy (Dortmund).

89' Mert Komur (Augsburg) creates himself some space and attempts to put the ball into the box. However, the defender gets an important foot in to clear. Augsburg force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
87' Anton Kade (Augsburg) hits a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box, but it's a comfortable save for Gregor Kobel as it's directed low at the middle of the goal.
87' Augsburg work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
86' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Carney Chukwuemeka (Dortmund) replaces Marcel Sabitzer.
86' Here is a change. Felix Nmecha is going off and Niko Kovac gives the last tactical orders to Julian Brandt (Dortmund).
85' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Maximilian Beier leaves the pitch and Yan Couto (Dortmund) comes on.
84' Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.

83' A tremendous drive by Karim Adeyemi (Dortmund) from inside the box towards the middle of the goal looks like it's in, but Finn Dahmen makes a brilliant save. The referee signals a corner kick to Dortmund.
82' Fabian Rieder (Augsburg) controls a cross inside the six-yard box, but unbelievably sends his shot wide of the right post.
82' Luca Reggiani (Dortmund) threads a pass through the eye of a needle into the box for Karim Adeyemi, but Finn Dahmen displays great awareness to stop him.
81' Marius Wolf (Augsburg) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
80' Manuel Baum prepares a substitution. Kristijan Jakic is replaced by Marius Wolf (Augsburg).
80' Mert Komur (Augsburg) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Rodrigo Ribeiro.
78' The resulting corner from Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
78' Marcel Sabitzer (Dortmund) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared. The ball goes out for a corner. Dortmund can continue in their attacking effort.
76' Arthur Chaves (Augsburg) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Bastian Dankert has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
74' Daniel Svensson (Dortmund) is substituted due to injury. Niko Kovac gives a chance to Fabio Silva.
72' Daniel Svensson (Dortmund) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
70' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Daniel Svensson (Dortmund).
70' The ball is cleared after Karim Adeyemi (Dortmund) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The referee points to the corner flag and Dortmund will take a corner.
68' Manuel Baum has decided to substitute Dimitrios Giannoulis and he is replaced by Michael Gregoritsch (Augsburg).
67' Robin Fellhauer (Augsburg) brings an opponent down and Bastian Dankert interrupts the game.
65' The percentage of ball possession is – 63:37.
63' Dortmund control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
60' Manuel Baum decides to make a substitution. Han-Noah Massengo will be replaced by Elvis Rexhbecaj (Augsburg).
60' We are about to witness a substitution. Anton Kade (Augsburg) is replacing Alexis Claude-Maurice.
59' 2 - 0 Luca Reggiani (Dortmund) meets the corner and displays his eye for goal as he coolly plants a header from close range into the right side of the goal. The score is 2:0.
58' Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
58' Marcel Sabitzer (Dortmund) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out. The linesman points to the corner flag, Dortmund are going to take it.
56' Dortmund enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
53' Daniel Svensson (Dortmund) whips in a cross from the corner, but Finn Dahmen is well positioned and punches the ball away.
52' Jobe Bellingham (Dortmund) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off. The ball is out of play and Dortmund manage to earn a corner.
52' Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
51' Maximilian Beier (Dortmund) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears. The ball goes out of play. Dortmund are awarded a corner kick.
50' Felix Nmecha (Dortmund) and Daniel Svensson attempt to exchange short two-yard passes, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
49' Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
48' Rodrigo Ribeiro (Augsburg) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
46' Daniel Svensson (Dortmund) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+2' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+1' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Daniel Svensson (Dortmund), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
45+1' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
45' A pass into the penalty area from Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) is intercepted by the defence. Dortmund have been awarded a corner kick.
45' Rodrigo Ribeiro (Augsburg) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
44' Julian Ryerson swings the cross over. Maximilian Beier (Dortmund) gets his head to it but it goes just over the crossbar.
43' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Dimitrios Giannoulis (Augsburg) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
41' Felix Nmecha (Dortmund) makes a rough challenge and Bastian Dankert blows his whistle for a foul.
40' Luca Reggiani (Dortmund) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Bastian Dankert blows his whistle for a foul.
39' The Dortmund players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
37' Alexis Claude-Maurice (Augsburg) turns on the edge of the box and immediately fires in a shot at goal, but the keeper can relax as it spins well wide of the left post.
36' A cross is slung in towards the penalty spot and Karim Adeyemi (Dortmund) creates space for himself but sends his header inches over the bar.
35' Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.

35' Jobe Bellingham (Dortmund) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the top right corner, but Finn Dahmen has it covered and makes a comfortable save. Corner kick. Dortmund will have an opportunity.
34' Waldemar Anton (Dortmund) rises high to meet a cross from the corner kick and plants a header from inside the penalty area. His effort went just narrowly wide of the left post.
34' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Dortmund.
33' Karim Adeyemi (Dortmund) latches onto a good pass inside the box and shoots. The effort beats the keeper, but deflects off the crossbar to safety.
32' Alexis Claude-Maurice (Augsburg) commits a rough challenge and Bastian Dankert blows his whistle for a foul.
31' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Dortmund.
31' A corner kick by Dortmund is thwarted by the well prepared Finn Dahmen (Augsburg). Dortmund will take a corner kick.

30' Karim Adeyemi (Dortmund) collects a brilliant pass inside the box and finds himself in a goal scoring opportunity. He takes a shot, but the effort is well blocked by one of the defending players. It will be a corner kick for Dortmund.
30' Maximilian Beier (Dortmund) expertly controls a neat clever pass inside the box, but his effort crashes against the crossbar! What an opportunity that was!
28' Dortmund seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
26' Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) serves up a nice cross, but Finn Dahmen punches the ball away.
24' Rodrigo Ribeiro (Augsburg) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.

23' Gregor Kobel doesn't have to worry about this one. Finn Dahmen plays a pass into the feet of Rodrigo Ribeiro (Augsburg), who is unable to find the target as his effort from inside the box goes well wide of the right post.
22' Poor challenge! Karim Adeyemi (Dortmund) is penalised for tripping and Bastian Dankert blows his whistle.
21' Maximilian Beier (Dortmund) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation.
19' Alexis Claude-Maurice (Augsburg) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
18' Maximilian Beier (Dortmund) attempts to set up his teammate with a scoring opportunity by chipping in a fine pass from the edge of the box, but one of the defenders intercepts his effort.
17' Maximilian Beier (Dortmund) jumps into a tackle and Bastian Dankert signals a foul.
16' Robin Fellhauer (Augsburg) is unable to feed a through ball into the path of his teammates. The ball goes out of play and Dortmund will have a goal kick.
13' 1 - 0 Karim Adeyemi (Dortmund) receives a killer pass, finds himself one-on-one with the goalkeeper and coolly sends the ball into the back of the net.
11' Good movement by Daniel Svensson (Dortmund), but he can't find any of his teammates as the cross is poor.
10' Gregor Kobel is alert and has a clear sight of a long through ball from Alexis Claude-Maurice (Augsburg). Easy save!
9' Maximilian Beier (Dortmund) sends a cross into the box, but Finn Dahmen comes off his line to gather the ball.
8' Rodrigo Ribeiro (Augsburg) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Bastian Dankert blows his whistle for an infringement.
6' Marcel Sabitzer (Dortmund) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
5' Rodrigo Ribeiro (Augsburg) finds his teammate inside the box with a sweet pass. However, Fabian Rieder wasn't able to finish and lost the ball.
4' Cedric Zesiger (Augsburg) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Gregor Kobel intercepts the ball.
3' Daniel Svensson (Dortmund) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
2' Waldemar Anton (Dortmund) fails to find a teammate across the pitch with a long ball.
1' The first half has just begun.
Augsburg will kick-off.
Bastian Dankert will referee today's match.
